position.px_units: 256x256 frame; disk radius ~10.6 px; mean source-to-twin disk gap 58.1 px (session2_future_position.json)

twin_context_reference.note: carriers (200 test clips) x 4 targets; the predictor's forecast from the rendered twin's own context

gate.rule: step 2 if MAE <= ~20.0 deg or px well below the 58 px source-twin gap; stop if MAE > ~40.0 deg

definitions.shuffled45: target (j+1) mod 4 of the same carrier; all 4 targets lie inside one 45-deg arc
definitions.flipped180: direction target + 180 deg; for position, the twin trajectory reflected about the source's tubelet-0 centroid (ignores frame edges)
definitions.R_dir_real_change: <P_edit - P_src, u(target) - u(source)> / ||u(target) - u(source)||^2 in the native probe's [sin, cos] output space, u = unit vector of the true angle
definitions.R_px_real_change: <p_edit - p_src, twin_true - src_true> / ||twin_true - src_true||^2 over the 4 future steps, native position probe, true pixel centroids
definitions.R_token_realdiff_session2: probe-free token R from session2_predictor.json, copied for reference

provenance.readout: probes fit on the predictor's own unedited forecasts of the 480 probe clips (folds 3-4)
